description: Starts a live session paused inside one Playwright test on Endform's remote infrastructure. Test selection follows Playwright conventions and must match exactly one test; narrow it with testFileFilters, grep, grepInvert, or project. Playwright grep patterns match the full title chain. A testFileFilter may include file.spec.ts:LINE to select a test declaration. The separate line input is the 1-based source line to pause before and defaults to the first statement inside the selected test body. Returns a sessionId, checkpoint, paths, and an inline initial ARIA snapshot. Then use live_test_run and call live_test_stop when finished. Startup may take a few minutes; sessions end automatically after 15 minutes.

config.description: Playwright configuration file or test directory, like Playwright `--config`.

grep.description: Only selects tests whose full Playwright title chain matches these regular expressions, including the project, file, describe blocks, and test title.

grepInvert.description: Excludes tests with titles matching these regular expressions, like Playwright `--grep-invert`.

line.description: 1-based source line to pause before. Defaults to the first statement inside the selected test body.

organizationId.description: Endform organization ID. Defaults to the organization configured for the repository or active login.

project.description: Only selects tests from these Playwright projects, like Playwright `--project`.

testFileFilters.description: Filters test files using regular expressions matched against absolute paths, like Playwright positional test filters. A filter may include a test declaration line, for example `tests/checkout.spec.ts:47`.

name: live_test_start
